Quote URL + date for every claim; mark MEASURED vs ESTIMATE. Write your full digest to /home/ubuntu/work/agi/.agi/context/local-maxxing/troves/2026-09-18-typesafe/concepts-api.md (one file, markdown, sections: Sources read / Decision types / Request-response schemas / Probability and confidence semantics / Limits (context, rate, state size, choice count) / Errors and versioning / Fit for the town). Already known, do not re-derive, only extend or correct with a citation if wrong: POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, Authorization Bearer API_KEY, model jev-latest, three primitives noul/choice/score (see .agi/context/local-maxxing/papers/typesafe-ai.md for the exact request/response shapes already captured), errors 401/422/429/529 with exponential backoff. HUNT, starting from https://docs.typesafe.ai/api.md and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/typesafe-ai/skills/main/skills/typesafe-ai/SKILL.md, then follow every doc link you find on docs.typesafe.ai: (1) every decision type that exists (confirm noul/choice/score are the only three, or find more); (2) the full request and response JSON schema for each, including any optional fields not in the digest already read; (3) what the probability/confidence numbers actually mean (calibration claims, how confidence differs from the primitives own probability field); (4) context/state size limits, rate limits, batching, any limit on the number of criteria in a choice or score; (5) the complete error list beyond 401/422/429/529 and what triggers each; (6) API versioning -- is jev-latest pinned or floating, is there a dated/versioned model name available. Visit at least 12 distinct pages (docs.typesafe.ai/* primarily) or say plainly in the digest which topics had fewer than 12 pages and why. End with a short list of anything that changed or added to what .agi/context/local-maxxing/papers/typesafe-ai.md already says, since that file is 19 lines and clearly incomplete.

Quote URL + date for every claim; mark MEASURED vs ESTIMATE. Write your full digest to /home/ubuntu/work/agi/.agi/context/local-maxxing/troves/2026-09-18-typesafe/pricing-legal.md (one file, markdown, sections: Sources read / Pricing per decision type / Billing granularity / Data handling, retention and privacy / Security / Terms that bind us / Fit for the town). Already known (owner-stated, not yet confirmed on any page): $0.045 per million input tokens, $0 output tokens -- CONFIRM this against the actual pricing page if one exists, or say plainly it remains owner-stated/unconfirmed if none is public. HUNT, starting from https://typesafe.ai (marketing site) and https://docs.typesafe.ai, then any linked pricing, terms-of-service, privacy-policy or security page: (1) is pricing published anywhere, and does it differ by primitive (noul vs choice vs score) or by state size -- quote the number and the URL, or ABSENT; (2) billing granularity -- per-call, per-token, per-seat, minimum spend, free tier; (3) what happens to the request state (the application data sent in every call) -- is it logged, used for training, retained, and for how long; (4) any published security posture (SOC2, encryption at rest/in transit, data residency); (5) terms of service clauses that would actually bind this town if we send it real (redacted) internal state -- IP ownership of outputs, liability caps, anything unusual. Visit at least 12 distinct pages or say plainly which topics had fewer and why. This digest never needs a live API key -- if any page requires auth to view, log its URL and skip it rather than trying to authenticate.
